$comment: The registry of meaning keys exporters put on `unsupported` coverage rows (report.json `meaning`). scripts/gen-catalog-signals.mjs groups rows by these keys into docs/findings/catalog-signals.md and fails on a key that is not listed here. A status changes when a proposal or a worklog settles the question; update `ref` with it. Statuses: open, watch, disagreement, rejected, target-specific, promoted (docs/specs/validation-and-coverage.md, "Catalog signals").

breakpoint.ladder.summary: Responsive breakpoints and container widths. `semantic.breakpoint.*` ships, but the target's ladder agrees with it on one rung only, and rebinding it would move every responsive boundary.

chart.series-style.summary: Series-type styling (candlestick colours, gauge bands): chart configuration, not design-token semantics.

color.wide-gamut.summary: A wide-gamut (P3) variant of each colour. Radix ships a P3 pair per scale; the IR holds one OKLCH value per slot. Single-source so far.

color.gradient.summary: A default gradient (start colour, end colour, angle) for a gradient variant: the IR has no gradient. Single-source so far (Mantine's `defaultGradient`).

color.named-palette.summary: The target's own named colours and palettes (Mantine's `white`, `black`, `red`, `teal`; Chakra's hue palettes, their ramps and its `black` and `white`), kept beside the design system's roles: what they seed on the page is set directly from the catalog, and the rest is the target's colour vocabulary, not a design-token concept.

effect.blur.summary: A blur-radius scale for backdrop and filter blur: the IR has no blur. Single-source so far (Chakra's `blurs`).

geometry.component.summary: Bespoke component geometry (spinner, popover, modal widths, offcanvas, dropdown and toast widths): one-sided or false friends when measured against the second reference target.

geometry.indicator.summary: Indicator and control-box sizes (carousel indicator, checkbox box, switch track): both reference targets have the concept and model it incompatibly (em and one axis against rem, two axes and a ladder).

icon.asset.summary: Embedded icon and glyph images (SVG data URIs): the IR has no asset vocabulary. Single-source so far.

icon.size.summary: Component icon sizes. PrimeNG models them systematically, Bootstrap has a few ad-hoc ones; revisit when a third target brings a systematic icon-size concept.

motion.keyframes.summary: A named keyframe animation (spin, ping, pulse, bounce) as a theme token: the IR has durations and easings, no animations. Single-source so far (Chakra's `animations`).

opacity.component.summary: Per-component opacities that are not `semantic.opacity.disabled`: a veil strength, a shimmer range, a glyph alpha. A candidate only once a second target needs the identical one.

opacity.compositional.summary: A catalog opacity the target composes against its own resting alpha, so the catalog value can't be written as is: it needs a compositional recipe (catalog factor × the target's resting value).

scale.extra-rung.summary: A rung the target's scale has beyond the catalog's: a weight below regular or above bold, a half or a large spacing step, a duration, a layer or a shadow size outside the catalog's ladder. Mapping it would invent a value the design system never set. Single-source so far (Chakra's tokens, measured against its whole surface).

shadow.inset.summary: An inset shadow: the elevation shadows have no inset counterpart in the IR.

style.effect.summary: Theme-level stylistic effects and control-size scales (daisyUI --depth, --noise, --size-selector, --size-field): themable, but the IR has no vocabulary for them. Single-source so far.

target.config.summary: Target configuration rather than a design value: behaviour switches (focus-ring visibility, reduced motion, cursor, font smoothing), class names, algorithm parameters (Mantine's autoContrast luminance threshold, its global rem scale) and constants (the colour-scheme name, Chakra's CSS keywords, fraction and viewport sizes, media aspect ratios).

type.display-ladder.summary: The display type sizes. `semantic.type.role.display.*` ships, but the target's ladder has twice the rungs over a different range, so mapping either invents rungs or drops them.

type.text-wrap.summary: How headings wrap (`text-wrap: wrap | balance | pretty`): the IR has no text-wrap slot. Single-source so far (Mantine's `headings.textWrap`).
